Um, continuous fluctuation? I don't know... maybe? I really haven't been keeping track of the switches, to be honest. It's just hard to tell when one thing ends and another begins. 

Kind of like how my lease started on the first, but I didn't actually get the keys until the third because the property manager went on vacation. Which is just wild to me. Who goes on vacation at the beginning of the month when rent is due and people are moving in? He went to Cabo, too, because I saw his out-of-office email. I've always wanted to go to Cabo, but the flights are just ridiculously expensive right now. I was looking at flights to Mexico last night instead of sleeping, actually, because I got this targeted ad for a boutique hotel in Tulum that has these incredible hanging macrame chairs in the lobby. I spent like three hours trying to source the exact same chairs for a client's patio redesign, but the shipping costs from the artisans in Mexico were astronomical. And then you have to deal with customs, which is a total nightmare. I ordered this vintage rug from Morocco once, and it sat in customs for six weeks. When it finally arrived, it smelled like wet dog and mothballs.
